    "raw": "여유도 생겼고..."
  },
  {
    "text_id": "Character_Zani_66_5",
    "locale_db": "ko/lang_multi_text.db",
    "kind": "대사",
    "speaker_id": 1477,
    "talk_id": 5,
    "option": "",
    "action_path": "/1",
    "status": "OK",
    "raw": "시간이 벌써..."
  },
  {
    "text_id": "Character_Zani_66_6",
    "locale_db": "ko/lang_multi_text.db",
    "kind": "대사",
    "speaker_id": 717,
    "talk_id": 6,
    "option": "",
    "action_path": "/1",
    "status": "OK",
    "raw": "사람 살려!"
  },
  {
    "text_id": "Character_Zani_66_7",
    "locale_db": "ko/lang_multi_text.db",
    "kind": "대사",
    "speaker_id": 200128,
    "talk_id": 7,
    "option": "",
    "action_path": "/1",
    "status": "OK",
    "raw": "헤헤헤"
  },
  {
    "text_id": "Character_Zani_66_8",
    "locale_db": "ko/lang_multi_text.db",
    "kind": "대사",
    "speaker_id": 200128,
    "talk_id": 8,
    "option": "",
    "action_path": "/1",
    "status": "OK",
    "raw": "그냥 운이 없었다고 생각해!"
  },
  {
    "text_id": "Character_Zani_66_9",
    "locale_db": "ko/lang_multi_text.db",
    "kind": "대사",
    "speaker_id": 1477,
    "talk_id": 9,
    "option": "",
    "action_path": "/1",
    "status": "OK",
    "raw": "어이"
  },
  {
    "text_id": "Character_Zani_66_10",
    "locale_db": "ko/lang_multi_text.db",
    "kind": "대사",
    "speaker_id": 717,
    "talk_id": 10,
    "option": "",
    "action_path": "/1",
    "status": "OK",
    "raw": "감사합니다! 감사해요!"
  },
  {
    "text_id": "Character_Zani_66_11",
    "locale_db": "ko/lang_multi_text.db",
    "kind": "대사",
    "speaker_id": 1477,
    "talk_id": 11,
    "option": "",
    "action_path": "/1",
    "status": "OK",
    "raw": "감사라..."
  },
  {
    "text_id": "Character_Zani_66_12",
    "locale_db": "ko/lang_multi_text.db",
    "kind": "대사",
    "speaker_id": 1477,
    "talk_id": 12,
    "option": "",
    "action_path": "/1",
    "status": "OK",
    "raw": "내가 그런 말을 해본 적이 있던가?"
  },
  {
    "text_id": "Character_Zani_66_13",
    "locale_db": "ko/lang_multi_text.db",
    "kind": "대사",
    "speaker_id": 1477,
    "talk_id": 13,
    "option": "",
    "action_path": "/1",
    "status": "OK",
    "raw": "그때 난... 무슨 생각을 하고 있었을까?"
  },
  {
    "text_id": "Character_Zani_66_14",
    "locale_db": "ko/lang_multi_text.db",
    "kind": "대사",
    "speaker_id": 1477,
    "talk_id": 14,
    "option": "",
    "action_path": "/1",
    "status": "OK",
    "raw": "나 대신 나서줄 사람을..."
  },
  {
    "text_id": "Character_Zani_66_15",
    "locale_db": "ko/lang_multi_text.db",
    "kind": "대사",
    "speaker_id": 1477,
    "talk_id": 15,
    "option": "",
    "action_path": "/1",
    "status": "OK",
    "raw": "바랐지"
  },
  {
    "text_id": "Character_Zani_66_16",
    "locale_db": "ko/lang_multi_text.db",
    "kind": "대사",
    "speaker_id": 1477,
    "talk_id": 16,
    "option": "",
    "action_path": "/1",
    "status": "OK",
    "raw": "...산책도 나쁘지 않네"
  },
  {
    "text_id": "Character_Zani_66_17",
    "locale_db": "ko/lang_multi_text.db",
    "kind": "대사",
    "speaker_id": 200129,
    "talk_id": 17,
    "option": "",
    "action_path": "/1",
    "status": "OK",
    "raw": "넌 뭐야?!"
  },
  {
    "text_id": "Character_Zani_66_18",
    "locale_db": "ko/lang_multi_text.db",
    "kind": "대사",
    "speaker_id": 200129,
    "talk_id": 18,
    "option": "",
    "action_path": "/1",
    "status": "OK",
    "raw": "끼어들지 마!"
  },
  {
    "text_id": "Character_Zani_66_19",
    "locale_db": "ko/lang_multi_text.db",
    "kind": "대사",
    "speaker_id": 200129,
    "talk_id": 19,
    "option": "",
    "action_path": "/1",
    "status": "OK",
    "raw": "넌 어제 그..."
  },
  {
    "text_id": "Character_Zani_66_20",
    "locale_db": "ko/lang_multi_text.db",
    "kind": "대사",
    "speaker_id": 200129,
    "talk_id": 20,
    "option": "",
    "action_path": "/1",
    "status": "OK",
    "raw": "으악..."
  },
  {
    "text_id": "Character_Zani_66_21",
    "locale_db": "ko/lang_multi_text.db",
    "kind": "대사",
    "speaker_id": 200130,
    "talk_id": 21,
    "option": "",
    "action_path": "/1",
    "status": "OK",
    "raw": "야, 너도 들었어?"
  },
  {
    "text_id": "Character_Zani_66_22",
    "locale_db": "ko/lang_multi_text.db",
    "kind": "대사",
    "speaker_id": 200130,
    "talk_id": 22,
    "option": "",
    "action_path": "/1",
    "status": "OK",
    "raw": "그거 있잖아..."
  },
  {
    "text_id": "Character_Zani_66_25",
    "locale_db": "ko/lang_multi_text.db",
    "kind": "대사",
    "speaker_id": 1477,
    "talk_id": 23,
    "option": "",
    "action_path": "/1",
    "status": "OK",
    "raw": "「불빛의 야행자」..."
  },
  {
    "text_id": "Character_Zani_66_26",
    "locale_db": "ko/lang_multi_text.db",
    "kind": "대사",
    "speaker_id": 1477,
    "talk_id": 24,
    "option": "",
    "action_path": "/1",
    "status": "OK",

  {
    "text_id": "Character_Zani_66_27",
    "locale_db": "ko/lang_multi_text.db",
    "kind": "대사",
    "speaker_id": 1477,
